mapper.select: SELECT r.role_id AS roleId, r.role_code AS roleCode, r.role_nm AS roleNm, CAST(NULL AS varchar) AS roleDc, CASE WHEN r.role_code = 'PLATFORM_ADMIN' THEN 1 WHEN r.role_code = 'TENANT_ADMIN' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END AS roleLevel, 'Y' AS tenantScoped, r.use_at AS useAt, r.created_at AS frstRegistPnttm, 'SYSTEM' AS frstRegisterId, r.updated_at AS lastUpdtPnttm, 'SYSTEM' AS lastUpdusrId FROM tb_role r ORDER BY roleLevel, roleCode

SELECT r.role_id AS roleId, r.role_code AS roleCode, r.role_nm AS roleNm, CAST(NULL AS varchar) AS roleDc, CASE WHEN r.role_code = 'PLATFORM_ADMIN' THEN 1 WHEN r.role_code = 'TENANT_ADMIN' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END AS roleLevel, 'Y' AS tenantScoped, r.use_at AS useAt, r.created_at AS frstRegistPnttm, 'SYSTEM' AS frstRegisterId, r.updated_at AS lastUpdtPnttm, 'SYSTEM' AS lastUpdusrId FROM tb_role r WHERE 1 = 1
AND r.use_at = #{useAt}
AND r.role_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%')
AND r.role_nm LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%')
AND r.role_nm LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%')
ORDER BY roleLevel, roleCode OFFSET #{firstIndex} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{recordCountPerPage} ROWS ONLY

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM tb_role r WHERE 1 = 1
AND r.use_at = #{useAt}
AND r.role_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%')

AND r.role_nm LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_role ( tenant_id, role_code, role_nm, use_at, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( (SELECT TOP 1 tenant_id FROM tb_tenant WHERE tenant_code = 'PLATFORM' ORDER BY tenant_id), #{roleCode}, #{roleNm}, #{useAt}, GETDATE(), GETDATE() )
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_role SET role_nm = #{roleNm}, use_at = #{useAt}, updated_at = GETDATE() WHERE role_id = #{roleId}
UPDATE tb_role SET use_at = #{useAt}, updated_at = GETDATE() WHERE role_id = #{roleId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM tb_role_menu_permission WHERE role_id = ( SELECT TOP 1 role_id FROM tb_role WHERE role_code = #{value} ORDER BY role_id )
mapper.select: SELECT m.menu_id AS menuId, m.menu_code AS menuCode, m.menu_nm AS menuNm, ISNULL(m.menu_dc, '') AS menuDc, m.parent_menu_id AS parentMenuId, m.menu_order AS menuOrdr, m.menu_url AS menuUrl, ISNULL(m.icon_nm, 'Menu') AS iconNm, m.use_at AS useAt, CASE WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN p.permission_code = 'PERM_WRITE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 THEN 'write' ELSE 'read' END AS permissionLevel, 1 AS accessible FROM tb_menu m INNER JOIN tb_role_menu_permission rmp ON m.menu_id = rmp.menu_id INNER JOIN tb_permission p ON rmp.permission_id = p.permission_id INNER JOIN tb_role r ON rmp.role_id = r.role_id INNER JOIN tb_tenant_subscription ts ON ts.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND ts.subscription_status = 'ACTIVE' INNER JOIN tb_plan_menu pm ON pm.plan_id = ts.plan_id AND pm.menu_code = m.menu_code AND pm.use_at = 'Y' WHERE m.use_at = 'Y' AND p.use_at = 'Y' AND r.role_code = #{value} GROUP BY m.menu_id, m.menu_code, m.menu_nm, m.menu_dc, m.parent_menu_id, m.menu_order, m.menu_url, m.icon_nm, m.use_at ORDER BY m.parent_menu_id, m.menu_order, m.menu_id
